subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw establish current-session-scoped, deferred `resetSession(reason?)` as a supported API for successful after-compaction plugin hooks?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately narrower than the closed arbitrary-session proposal, but it still adds a destructive session-lifecycle capability to the public plugin hook context and therefore needs an owner decision on the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the after-compaction-only, current-session, deferred API after documentation, passing required checks, and real reset-plus-next-turn proof are added.

options.title: Keep reset host-internal
options.body: Do not expose session reset through plugin hook context and instead implement any required recovery as owner-specific host policy or a narrower internal callback.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the after-compaction-only, current-session, deferred API after documentation, passing required checks, and real reset-plus-next-turn proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history signal across session reset lifecycle and plugin-versus-core scope decisions.
